title: Goods 15 - Goods Vehicle Taxation and Tolls
source: Motor tax rates (Department of Transport / Citizens Information); county council guidance on form RF111A; Dublin City Council HGV Management Strategy

questions.q: On what basis is annual motor tax calculated for a goods vehicle in Ireland?
questions.exp:
Goods vehicles are taxed on unladen weight (the weight of the vehicle without its load). Cars are taxed on CO2 and buses on seating capacity.
📍 Citizens Information, motor tax rates

questions.q: What is the annual motor tax on a goods vehicle with an unladen weight of up to 3,000 kg?
questions.exp:
Up to 3,000 kg unladen: €333 a year. The next band, 3,001 to 4,000 kg, pays €420.
📍 Motor tax rates for goods vehicles

questions.q: What is the annual motor tax on a goods vehicle with an unladen weight between 4,001 kg and 12,000 kg?
questions.exp:
4,001 to 12,000 kg unladen: €500 a year. Over 12,000 kg: €900.
📍 Citizens Information, motor tax rates

questions.q: What is the annual motor tax on a goods vehicle with an unladen weight over 12,000 kg?
questions.exp:
Over 12,000 kg unladen: €900 a year, the top goods band since the 2016 simplification.
📍 Citizens Information, motor tax rates

questions.q: To tax a light goods vehicle (up to 3,500 kg) at the commercial rate for the first time, the owner must complete:
questions.exp:
Light goods vehicles up to 3,500 kg need the Goods Only Declaration, form RF111A, to be taxed at the goods rate.
📍 County council motor tax guidance; Dáil answer on RF111A

questions.q: Where is the RF111A Goods Only Declaration signed?
options: At a solicitor's or notary's office
At a Garda station, before a Garda
At the NCT or CVRT test centre
questions.exp:
The applicant signs the RF111A at a Garda station and a Garda witnesses the signature. It includes the income tax number and the nature of the trade or business.
📍 County council motor tax guidance

questions.q: When is a new RF111A normally needed?
options: Every time the tax is renewed
First tax, new owner, or private to commercial
Only when the vehicle is sold abroad
Only after an accident or a write-off
questions.exp:
Councils ask for it when a light goods vehicle is first taxed, when ownership changes, and when the tax is switched from the private to the commercial rate.
📍 County council motor tax guidance

questions.q: A van taxed at the goods rate is used for private family trips. What is the rule?
options: It is fine at weekends and holidays
It must then be taxed at the private rate
Only the insurance policy must change
It is allowed up to 1,000 km a year
questions.exp:
The goods rate is only for vehicles used in the course of a trade or business. A goods vehicle used privately must be taxed at the private rate like any other private vehicle.
📍 County council motor tax guidance

questions.q: What must a commercial goods vehicle over one year old have before motor tax can be paid?
options: A valid CRW from the CVRT
questions.exp:
Commercial vehicles need a current CRW (issued after passing the CVRT) before they can be taxed.
📍 RSA, CVRT

questions.q: How much toll does a heavy goods vehicle pay to use the Dublin Port Tunnel?
options: The same toll as a private car
Nothing: it is free for HGVs
questions.exp:
The Dublin Port Tunnel is free for HGVs, to take them off city streets; cars pay a toll designed to discourage commuter traffic.
📍 Dublin City Council HGV Management Strategy

questions.q: Under Dublin City Council's HGV Management Strategy, which lorries are banned from the city-centre cordon between 7am and 7pm without a permit?
options: HGVs with five or more axles
questions.exp:
Since 19 February 2007, HGVs with five or more axles may not enter the cordon area between 07:00 and 19:00 without a permit, seven days a week. Permits exist for deliveries inside the cordon and for vehicles that cannot use the Port Tunnel.
📍 Dublin City Council HGV Management Strategy

questions.q: A five-axle HGV must make a delivery inside the Dublin city cordon at 11am. What does it need?
options: Nothing if the driver is local
A permit from Dublin City Council
A CMR note stamped by the port
questions.exp:
Deliveries inside the cordon during 07:00-19:00 need a permit. Driving in without one can be fined.
📍 Dublin City Council HGV Management Strategy

questions.q: How is the M50 toll paid by a lorry?
options: At a toll barrier, in coins
Via eFlow: plate camera, tag or online
It is free for all goods vehicles
questions.exp:
The M50 uses eFlow: there are no barriers, cameras read the number plate, and the toll is paid with a tag, an account or online by 8pm the next day.
📍 TII eFlow

questions.q: Which HGVs pay the UK HGV Road User Levy when driving in Great Britain?
options: HGVs of 12 t or more, foreign too
questions.exp:
The HGV Road User Levy applies to HGVs of 12 tonnes or more on GB roads, whether UK or foreign-registered. Foreign hauliers buy it before the journey.
📍 UK HGV Road User Levy

questions.q: Germany's distance-based lorry toll (LKW-Maut) is collected by:
questions.exp:
Germany's LKW-Maut is run by Toll Collect: the vehicle pays per km with an on-board unit or by booking the route in advance. The amount depends on weight, axles and CO2 class.
📍 Toll Collect
